name: SimplifiedJFETModels
_comment_tr: JFET kucuk-sinyal sablonu - Simplified seviye (Analog Insydes SimplifiedJFETSmallSignal, simp==1). Basic'e ek olarak gecit-kanal jonksiyonlarinin sizinti iletkenlikleri: R_gd = 1/GGD (G-D) ve R_gs = 1/GGS (G-S). Seri ohmik RD/RS yine ihmal. GGD/GGS cogu PSpice .out'unda yoktur (GMIN mertebesi), o durumda dejenerasyon temizleme bu direncleri dusurur ve model Basic'e iner. Deger cozumu netlist/Model.py._jfet_ac_param_values.
_comment_en: JFET small-signal template - Simplified level (Analog Insydes SimplifiedJFETSmallSignal, simp==1). Basic plus the gate-channel junction leak conductances: R_gd = 1/GGD (G-D) and R_gs = 1/GGS (G-S). Series ohmic RD/RS still neglected. GGD/GGS are absent from most PSpice .out files (GMIN-level); when so the degeneracy cleanup drops these resistors and the model collapses to Basic. Value resolution in netlist/Model.py._jfet_ac_param_values.
